items.title: Solana lending giant Jupiter now lets the same dollar earn twice
items.whyYouShouldCare: Jupiter's new feature allows users to earn on their assets more efficiently, potentially increasing liquidity and usage within the Solana ecosystem.

items.title: This corporate Solana treasury dumped $12.5M of SOL at a 54% loss – and its balance sheet still shrank
items.whyYouShouldCare: The significant loss from the corporate treasury's SOL sale raises concerns about institutional confidence and could impact overall market sentiment towards Solana.

items.title: Crypto braces for high-stakes inflation week – Will risk appetite return?
items.whyYouShouldCare: Upcoming inflation data could influence investor risk appetite, affecting trading volumes and liquidity for Solana and other cryptocurrencies.
